current.text: More than half the roster turned over. LeBron James left for the Sixers. Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves are the remaining core.
With LeBron James gone and Rui Hachimura apparently gone too, about 64 starting minutes are open at forward. This opens up big usage for the players who remain.
Walker Kessler is the starting center.
The backup centers are weak, so the team depends on Kessler, especially on defense. If he is out, they would have to rely on Kevon Looney or Sandro Mamukelashvili.
Kevon Looney is the listed backup center, so Mamukelashvili should get the backup center minutes behind Kessler.
The core is Doncic, Reaves, Mamukelashvili and Kessler. Quentin Grimes and Jake LaRavia are likely in the rotation.
Two starting spots are open, mainly between Grimes, LaRavia and Mamukelashvili. Ziaire Williams might also start.
Whoever of that group comes off the bench will probably still play about 27 minutes.
The rotation choices under coach J.J. Redick are unclear.
The front office wanted a younger, more athletic roster with more players who can dribble, pass and shoot.
The team is aiming for a top five offense and a middle of the pack defense.
Andy predicts 50 wins and a top six finish in the West. He thinks the lack of continuity probably keeps them out of the conference finals.
The Lakers project as a playoff team (win total 46.5, rank 11 of 30), so tanking or late-season shutdowns are unlikely.
Luka Doncic's health makes the Lakers more vulnerable than the top five West teams.
Lloyd thinks the roster lacks defenders around Doncic and Reaves. He does not expect it to go well.
The schedule is about average. The playoff weeks have 10 games with 2 back-to-back pairs, and week 21 has only 3 games.

tags.name: high roster turnover
tags.detail: More than half the roster changed. LeBron James and Rui Hachimura are gone, Walker Kessler and others are new.
tags.new_meaning: The team changed a large share of its roster since last season, so roles and usage are less predictable.

tags.name: unsettled rotation
tags.detail: Two starting spots open between Grimes, LaRavia, Mamukelashvili and possibly Ziaire Williams. Redick's choices are unclear.
tags.new_meaning: Starting spots or rotation roles are not decided yet, so minutes for several players are uncertain.

tags.name: playoff contender
tags.detail: Win total 46.5 (rank 11). Andy predicts 50 wins and a top six finish in the West.
tags.new_meaning: Expected to make the NBA playoffs, so tanking and late-season shutdowns are unlikely.

note: The Lakers lost LeBron James and Rui Hachimura, so Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves get big usage. Walker Kessler gets secure center minutes because the backups behind him are weak. Mamukelashvili gains as the likely backup center and a possible starter, while Grimes, LaRavia and Ziaire Williams fight for the other open spots. Watch Redick's preseason starting lineup and Doncic's health, since the team depends on him.
